opening.001: Please… let me stay. We have been walking for days, and I do not know how much longer the others can keep going.
opening.002: I am not asking for much. A roof, a meal, and a chance to be useful. Please let us join you.
opening.003: You have a settlement. We have nothing left but each other. If there is room, I will work for it.
response.settlement_admission.accepted.1: Thank you. I thought I would have to keep walking until there was nowhere left to go.
